title: What a data engineer does and how it differs from a data scientist

videos.script: Monday morning at a bicycle-sharing company. The operations manager asks a simple question. Which stations ran out of bicycles last week? {{question}} Nobody can answer it yet. The answer is spread over three systems. An app database, a sensor in every dock, and a spreadsheet the mechanics keep. {{three-systems}} Somebody has to copy all three out, every day, without losing one. Put them on one clock. Check that yesterday arrived. {{the-work}} That somebody is a data engineer. And when it works, nobody sees it. {{invisible}} This lesson is about that job. How it differs from the data scientist, who predicts. And from the analyst, who answers. {{roles}} Then you build the lab the whole course runs on. One directory, one Python, two libraries. {{lab}} And you run a first program. Six rides, one question, and two ways to break it. One of them stops with an error. The other one quietly counts a ride twice. {{two-failures}} The second kind is the one this course is about. {{end}}
